methodology.evaluated_weeks: 1 through 11; late-season underdetermined production fits excluded by design
methodology.weekly_freeze: before the first kickoff of each week; no same-week outcomes in snapshots or model training
methodology.common_opponent: all-team neutral comparisons, both orientations, equal 7-day rest
methodology.results_prior: preseason common-opponent model ratings; fixed 3-point home edge; lambda/cap selected on development MAE only
methodology.preseason_data_limitation: returning/talent/recruiting are season-level proxies without historical publication timestamps
methodology.historical_schedule_limitation: final archived schedules are used as schedule-known proxies
methodology.holdout_limitation: 2025 has previously been inspected for production model selection; untouched here means no ranking-parameter selection on 2025
